name: Acceptance test 21 - policy variables prevent exact resource resolution
note: IAM-706: s3:GetObject on a ${aws:username}-scoped resource yields a variable-scoped DATA-READ with the policy variable preserved VERBATIM (never resolved, never classified literal / wildcard-global / definitely single-user) and lower path-exploitability.
